\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 156-159 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R164-first-pass-words-from-chapters-156-159}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a pebble and earth.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item previous, following, public, private, personal
  \item a flat, a dining room, a balcony, a lock, a doorbell
  \item a mosquito, society, the government, a law, a court
  \item a battery, a charger, a singer, a show, an actor
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Previous? (\textbf{anterior}.) Following? (\textbf{seguinte}.) Public? (\textbf{público / pública}.) Private? (\textbf{privado / privada}.) Personal? (\textbf{pessoal}.) A flat? (\textbf{o apartamento}.) A dining room? (\textbf{a sala de jantar}.) A balcony? (\textbf{a varanda}.) A lock? (\textbf{a fechadura}.) A doorbell? (\textbf{a campainha}.) A mosquito? (\textbf{o mosquito}.) Society? (\textbf{a sociedade}.) The government? (\textbf{o governo}.) A law? (\textbf{a lei}.) A court? (\textbf{o tribunal}.) A battery? (\textbf{a bateria}.) A charger? (\textbf{o carregador}.) A singer? (\textbf{o cantor / a cantora}.) A show? (\textbf{o espetáculo}.) An actor? (\textbf{o ator}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 160-164 — a second pass}

  \item a possibility, a result, a difference, an example, the truth
  \item a debt, a tax, a form, an envelope, a parcel; an order
  \item a tunnel, building works, a block of flats, a castle, a tower
  \item a lawn, a path, a plain, a pebble, earth
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An accountant? (\textbf{o contabilista}.) A scientist? (\textbf{o cientista}.) A researcher? (\textbf{o investigador}.) A foreigner; abroad? (\textbf{o estrangeiro}.) A tourist? (\textbf{o turista}.) A possibility? (\textbf{a possibilidade}.) A result? (\textbf{o resultado}.) A difference? (\textbf{a diferença}.) An example? (\textbf{o exemplo}.) The truth? (\textbf{a verdade}.) A debt? (\textbf{a dívida}.) A tax? (\textbf{o imposto}.) A form? (\textbf{o formulário}.) An envelope? (\textbf{o envelope}.) A parcel; an order? (\textbf{a encomenda}.) A tunnel? (\textbf{o túnel}.) Building works? (\textbf{as obras}.) A block of flats? (\textbf{o prédio}.) A castle? (\textbf{o castelo}.) A tower? (\textbf{a torre}.) A lawn? (\textbf{o relvado}.) A path? (\textbf{o caminho}.) A plain? (\textbf{a planície}.) A pebble? (\textbf{o seixo}.) Earth? (\textbf{a terra}.)
